name: cat_cru_face3
subject: small black cat in a purple witch hat with a star and bell, purple cape, tiny dark nose, pinned flat with arms spread
desc: a very subtle change of expression only: the eyes close into thin gently curved dark lines, the brows tilt just slightly, the mouth stays small and closed in a slightly tense line. No teeth, no blush, no tears, no open mouth. Nothing else changes: same face shape, nose, whiskers, hat, pose, body and size
